subject: Cessation tracker (built, device-tested)
description: DONE 2026-06-04. Built /cessation: CessationGoal (substance, quit date, cold-turkey vs taper, baseline/day in counting units, optional pack pricing via PackName+UnitsPerPack) + CessationEvent (craving/slip, intensity 1-5, trigger chips, amount, note). Non-judgmental core: quit date never resets; 'days since last slip' tracked separately; week-over-week trend counts. Taper mode: quit date is a future target, daily allowance falls linearly from baseline to 0, one-tap 'Log 1 <unit>' against today's allowance ('over plan' flagged gently), quit-day notification, auto-flips to quit mode after. Craving SOS: log + 5-min ride-out countdown (beep/haptic, screen-awake, backup notification). Money saved slip-adjusted, pack-price converted. Milestones (1/3/7/14/30/90/180/365d) via one-shot notifications, included in the orphan sweep. Dashboard tile + Quick log entry render ONLY when an active goal exists (clean for TestFlight users); always reachable via More. AI privacy: excluded from all Gemini payloads by default, per-device opt-in toggle (ai_include_cessation) sends quit-days + counts to the daily check-in only, with supportive-tone instruction.
